atc_w.label: Mackinac Island – St. Ignace (Arnold Transit)
atc_w.src: Arnold Transit Company, Official Guide, August 1950 (Brendan, 20 Nov 2026; private repo scans/og1948_dssa/arnold_transit_og1950aug.png), standing in for July 1948: the May 1948 Guide prints three St. Ignace sailings and no times for the Mackinaw City and Les Cheneaux routes (resumed June 1 and June 16, 1948). Crossing times from the July 1958 Arnold Line brochure. Shown on the Pacific clock
